entities.name: Salvation
entities.description: An ancient entity manifesting as an ivory sphere, once a primal force of an earlier world and likely brought to Dominaria by Urza.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who likely brought Salvation to Dominaria.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin made immortal by the Salvation Sphere.

entities.name: Bulp
entities.description: Squee's ward, revealed to be the compleated Ertai.

entities.name: Phyrexian Ertai
entities.description: Compleated Phyrexian Ertai who came to torment Squee and take the Sphere.

entities.name: Legacy Weapon
entities.description: Legendary weapon of which the sphere is a part.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane to which the Phyrexians return.

events.summary: Hundreds of years later Squee finds a sleeper Phyrexian agent in his clan, and his ward Bulp is revealed as compleated Ertai, who seeks the Sphere and to compleat Squee.
Ertai and the infiltrated goblins torment and partially compleat Squee.
events.quote: subjected him to relentless torment and transformation

events.summary: Squee is crushed by boulders, causing an explosion that destroys the mountain and the Phyrexian agents.
events.quote: Squee was crushed by boulders, triggering an explosion that destroyed the mountain

events.summary: Squee finds himself in an ethereal realm where the Sphere grants him one last life before returning him to the living.
events.quote: It granted Squee one last life to live before sending him back to the realm of the living.

relations.note: Kept the sphere as his prized possession, gaining immortality
relations.quote: The goblin Squee kept the sphere as his most prized possession

relations.note: Came to torment and compleat him
relations.quote: who had come to torment Squee and recover the Salvation Sphere
